candidates.title: Burwash Hall
candidates.evidence: Burwash Hall is a residence building at Toronto's Victoria College. Construction began in 1911 and finished in 1913. Architect Henry Sproatt designed its Neo-Gothic turrets, gargoyles and battlements.
